items.title: Best "Strong Buy" Stocks to Buy Now and in December
items.summary: The article recommends investors consider Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks heading into the end of 2026, highlighting a screening strategy that filters over 200 highly-ranked stocks. Transcat (TRNS) is featured as an example, a calibration and maintenance services company for FDA-regulated industries that has shown strong earnings growth and is trading 36% below its 2024 highs with potential for technical breakout.

items.title: Recent Price Trend in Transcat (TRNS) is Your Friend, Here's Why
items.summary: Transcat, Inc. (TRNS) is highlighted as a suitable candidate for short-term trend investors based on Zacks' 'Recent Price Strength' screen. The stock has gained 8.3% over 12 weeks and 17.7% over the past four weeks, currently trading at 85.1% of its 52-week high-low range. TRNS carries a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating and an Average Broker Recommendation of #1, indicating strong fundamental strength and positive near-term price performance outlook.
